text: Somebody made care better today. Did anyone write it down?
I rewrote our handover checklist. Everyone uses it now. But it's not like anyone would call that an award.
This is Evinca. An independent healthcare publication, and an honours programme judged on evidence, for nurses, midwives, doctors, pharmacists and leaders, worldwide.
Every story of better care has someone who did the work, someone who noticed, and someone who was cared for. So, where do you come in?
Made something better? Tell your story. Saw someone do it? Nominate them. Were you cared for? Say thank you. Lead a team? Recognise your staff.
Some people will never put themselves forward. So I nominated her. It's free, it takes about five minutes, and they won't say it was me unless I want them to.
And to the night nurse on Ward four. You held my hand when I was scared. Now my thank-you reaches you, through the hospital.
But most people underestimate their own work. So Evinca has a free check. Two minutes, no account, nothing submitted and nothing scored.
Have you ever rewritten a handover? Caught an error before it reached a patient? Made a process safer, and can show the before and after? If you nodded at even one, you probably have a story.
Case one. A ward nurse in the United Kingdom. Patient safety and quality.
Can she describe the problem, what she did, and what changed? Yes. Evidence of change, with no patient-identifying data? Yes. Someone independent to confirm it? Yes.
Your evidence looks ready to shape. Honest, too. It tells her plainly: this does not predict selection.
Case two. A clinical educator in Saudi Arabia. Healthcare education.
A clear story? Yes. A baseline and a result? Not yet. Someone to confirm it? Yes.
Worth strengthening first. Not a rejection. It points to the one missing piece, and suggests a free Spotlight Story to start with today.
Your story saves as you go, stays private until you choose to submit it, and you add to it as your results come in.
When you're ready, there are four marks. Spotlight each month, Distinction each quarter, Honour each year, and Laureate for the very few. One verified record behind each.
Okay. Maybe my checklist is a story after all.
Your work already made a difference. Let Evinca make it visible. Start free today, at Evinca dot Healthcare Crown Academy dot co dot uk.
